image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned on a rocky surface with a dark fishing net in the background. The crab displays a broad, oval carapace with purplish-brown and cream coloration. Its robust claws are prominent, showing dark tips and serrated inner edges. Multiple walking legs extend laterally. A second, smaller crab or crab part is visible beneath the main subject.
